name: Lab monitor - eye tracker, Aflah grid
description: Eye tracker (Tobii Pro Fusion, 50-80 cm): Aflah grid, 68 spots 4 x 6 deg apart, at 55 cm with a chin rest. Full Threshold 4-2 staircase (OPI). Start python/specvis.sh tracker-bridge first. For comparing grids, run the "24-2 without top/bottom rows" eye-tracker preset on the same person. Screen: BenQ 24.5", 544 mm wide; choose the ColorCAL scale "Lab screen".
